clusters.headline: Twenty-Four Bodies Recovered From PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Factory Fire
aiSummaryBullets: Search and rescue teams have recovered 24 body bags from the site of the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia factory fire in Cikande.
Identification of the victims is expected to take several weeks and will involve DNA testing at the Bhayangkara Hospital.

clusters.headline: Persib Bandung Clinch 2-1 Comeback Victory Over Bali United
aiSummaryBullets: Persib Bandung defeated Bali United 2-1 in the tenth week of the 2026-2027 Super League season.
Luka Menalo scored the winning goal for Persib Bandung, securing the result despite the team playing with ten men.

clusters.headline: Marc Marquez Secures Eighth MotoGP World Title In Portugal 2026
aiSummaryBullets: Marc Marquez secured his eighth career MotoGP world championship title following the Portuguese Grand Prix.
The Ducati rider finished the race in eighth position to mathematically guarantee his overall victory for the 2026 season.

clusters.headline: Gunung Karangetang And Mount Semeru Record New Volcanic Activity
aiSummaryBullets: Gunung Karangetang in North Sulawesi erupted twice on November 22, causing lava flows to extend up to 400 meters.
Mount Semeru remains at Alert Level III following multiple recorded eruptions during the recent period.

clusters.headline: DPD RI Chair Sultan Najamudin Proposes Adding Three Vice Presidents
aiSummaryBullets: DPD RI Chair Sultan Najamudin introduced a proposal to increase the number of vice presidents to three.
Najamudin clarified that the suggestion is intended for long-term consideration rather than immediate implementation.

clusters.headline: Security Guard and Mob Target Police Vehicle in PIK Incident
aiSummaryBullets: A police vehicle in the Pantai Indah Kapuk area was targeted by a mob after being falsely accused of committing a hit-and-run.
A security guard climbed onto the hood of the moving police car, while others surrounded and attacked the vehicle.

clusters.headline: Three Dead And Dozens Missing Following Indonesia Factory Fire
aiSummaryBullets: At least three individuals have died following a large fire at a factory in Indonesia that produces sweets and snacks.
Emergency responders rescued 15 people from the facility, while 36 workers are currently reported as missing.

clusters.headline: Kapolda Metro Jaya Dadang Hartanto Rombak Jajaran Pejabat Baru
aiSummaryBullets: Kapolda Metro Jaya Komjen Dadang Hartanto memimpin perombakan jabatan strategis di lingkungan Polda Metro Jaya.
Perubahan posisi melibatkan berbagai level kepemimpinan mulai dari Kapolres, Kasat Reskrim, hingga Kapolsek dan Wakapolsek.

clusters.headline: Secondary Landslides Sever Jalan Langgar II In Pejaten Timur
aiSummaryBullets: Recurring landslides at Jalan Langgar II in Pejaten Timur have severed road access and blocked the PHB Poltangan water channel.
Rising water levels triggered by the blockage forced local residents to seek temporary shelter at a nearby prayer hall.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Holds Meeting With Gerindra Party Leaders
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto hosted senior Gerindra Party members at his private residence in Hambalang, Bogor.
The delegation included West Java Governor Dedi Mulyadi, Deputy Speaker of the DPR RI Sufmi Dasco Ahmad, and other party elite.

clusters.headline: Indonesia And European Union Formally Sign The IEU-CEPA Agreement
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia and the European Union officially signed the IEU-CEPA trade and investment agreement after a decade of negotiations.
The deal includes the elimination of most export tariffs, with officials targeting full implementation of the agreement by early 2027.

clusters.headline: Kapolri Suyudi Ario Seto Reports 600 Tons Of Seized Narcotics
aiSummaryBullets: National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto reported the seizure of 600 tons of narcotics over a two-month period.
The ongoing operation follows the recent disruption of an international drug syndicate operating through a scrap metal business.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Provinces Announce Varied 2027 Minimum Wage Increases
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta has set its 2027 provincial minimum wage at Rp6.1 million, a 7.1 percent increase that has drawn comparisons to Bekasi's higher rate.
Several regions have finalized their 2027 rates, including significant percentage hikes reported in Central Java, Bali, and Yogyakarta.

clusters.headline: Erick Thohir Confirms FIFA Contact Over PSS Sleman Fan Riots
aiSummaryBullets: PSSI Chairman Erick Thohir confirmed he has been in contact with FIFA regarding the recent spectator disturbances in Sleman.
PSSI has pledged full cooperation with national police to investigate the destruction of property, including burning the goal net.

clusters.headline: Banyuwangi, NTT, and Public Figures Receive Various 2026 Awards
aiSummaryBullets: Regional leaders including Banyuwangi and NTT received honors for poverty reduction and governance, while high-level officials were recognized for policy and parliamentary contributions.
Corporate entities such as bank bjb and Telkomsat earned national awards for economic growth, innovation, and sustainability efforts.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Traffic Adjustments For Guns N' Roses Concert At GBK
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta authorities have implemented traffic diversions and designated 11 parking locations around the Gelora Bung Karno stadium for the concert.
Public transport providers including Transjakarta and MRT have extended operational hours on select routes to assist attendees with travel.

clusters.headline: MPR Reviews Mahfud MD Concerns Over Vice President Election Date
aiSummaryBullets: Mahfud MD stated the vice president election scheduled for December 9, 2026, could be invalid due to procedural timeline issues.
The MPR Ad Hoc Committee is currently evaluating these concerns regarding the 14-day working deadline for candidate submission.

clusters.headline: Kemendagri Announces High-Performing Regional Governments Awards
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Home Affairs is awarding regional governments for excellence in administrative services and regional competitiveness.
Recognitions have been issued for the Nusa Tenggara and Maluku regions, with upcoming announcements scheduled for the Java and Bali areas.

clusters.headline: Ongoing Police Investigation Into Ketapang Child Abuse Case
aiSummaryBullets: Police are conducting an active investigation into a reported case of child abuse in Ketapang.
The case gained significant attention following viral reports of a mother allegedly assaulting her biological child.

clusters.headline: Kapolri Reassigns Three Generals Facing Wiretapping Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: Three police generals have been reassigned to the Yanma Polri following their designation as suspects in an illegal wiretapping case.
The Partai Keadilan Sejahtera has called for a transparent, fair, and professional investigation to identify the masterminds behind the incident.
